title: Trio Petroleum Corp Issues Broker-Dealer Action Notice Ahead of May 21, 2026 Annual Meeting
summary: Without enough votes, Trio’s May 21, 2026 meeting can’t consider proposals. See how brokers and street‑name holders are urged to submit instructions.

24h Move is the share-price change in the day after each event; other market factors may also have contributed.


**


Pattern Detected


Recent governance, financing, and operational updates often drew strong reactions, with a mix of positive alignment and occasional sell-the-news divergences.


**


Recent Company History


Over the past months, Trio has focused on capital raising, balance sheet cleanup, and operational ramp-up. It completed an ATM raise of **$19,017,527** , retired **$1.2 million** in convertible notes, and advanced Alberta assets toward initial production. More recently, it raised about **$24 million** and has repeatedly encouraged shareholder voting for the **May 21, 2026** annual meeting. Today’s broker-dealer action notice continues that governance push, aiming to secure quorum for strategic proposals.
